subject: Renewal amendment: APAC on-ramp + EU failover checklist
messages:
From: Ava Thompson <ava.thompson@novavitals.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ops Team <ops@novavitals.com>
Date: 2027-07-28 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal Q: add APAC on-ramp + EU failover

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the renewal reminder. We want to proceed with the 12-month renewal but need to add two items to the contract before signing:

1) APAC on-ramp: pilot capacity for SGP and SYD regions with a guaranteed baseline of 100 concurrent requests and burst to 1,000 for tiered pricing.
2) EU failover + data residency: primary EU residency for EU traffic, but ability to fail over to EU-hosted replicas from APAC outages (must still respect EU data retention rules and not replicate sensitive data outside EU for >24 hours).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support the cross-region failover constraints and provide an updated SOW and the cost delta? Also need SOC2 evidence and a short checklist we can give our security team.

Best,
Ava
Ava Thompson
Head of Platform Ops, NovaVitals
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-29 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal Q: add APAC on-ramp + EU failover

Hi Ava —

Thanks — great to hear you're moving forward. Short answers up front:
- Yes, we can enable an APAC on-ramp (SGP/SYD) as a contract amendment.
- EU primary residency with cross-region failover is supported under our regional routing + transient KV cache rules; we can commit to not store or persist EU-sensitive payloads outside EU beyond a 24-hour failover window.

I've attached a draft SOW that shows the APAC baseline/burst pricing, and a separate capacity workbook with bandwidth/CPU estimates for the pilot. High-level cost delta for the APAC on-ramp + EU failover guardrails is $14,500/month on top of your current committed reserved capacity (see SOW v3).

Next steps I propose:
- I'll loop in Marcus to validate pricing and capacity numbers.
- Stephanie will confirm the contract language required for the residency/failover clause and prepare a short security checklist (SOC2 snapshot + KMS rotation details).
- If this looks ok, we can push an amendment and a DocuSign envelope by next week.

Attaching:
- SOW_APAC_onramp_v3.pdf (draft)
- APAC_capacity_plan.xlsx (workbook)

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-07-30 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pricing check for NovaVitals APAC on-ramp

Rachel — quick internal note before I message Ava. Key points: 
- Baseline 100 concurrent -> expected token throughput ~1.3M tokens/day. Burst 1k concurrent -> peak tokens 12M/day.
- Proposed pricing delta of $14,500/mo assumes 4:1 burst-to-baseline inefficiency and includes managed failover routing fee ($2k/mo).
- If they want stronger SLA on failover (<1m RTO) we should charge additional $6k/mo and require reserved dedicated nodes in SYD/SGP.

Stephanie, legal ask: can we offer a 24-hour maximum cross-region replication window and call out that any EU-regulated PII must be routed to EU-only KV storage? If yes, I'll mark the deal with "APAC_WITH_EU_FAILOVER" plan and set provisioning to prefer reserved capacity.

I'll prepare an itemized appendix for the SOW and update the capacity workbook today.

-Marcus
